Taylor: Hey folks, first-day hiccup. I can't find the 'New Hire Onboarding Checklist' template under /docs and the 'Duplicate to space' dropdown only shows my personal workspace. Who owns templates?
Nora (DevEx): Welcome Taylor! Templates live in /docs -> People Ops -> Templates. If the duplicate target doesn't show 'Redwood', you likely don't have Editor on the People Ops space. Which email did you sign up with?
Taylor: taylor.dev+redwood@gmail.com. I can view the page but the duplicate action is disabled (grey).
Victor: That's standard: org templates require Editor on that space. DevEx or People Ops can grant. We also have a self-serve request form: https://redwood.example.com/docs-access (choose space = People Ops, role = Editor).
Taylor: Is there a faster way? I need to complete the onboarding checklist for my manager by EOD.
Nora (DevEx): If it's urgent, ping the Docs-bot: `@Docs-bot request temp-editor taylor.dev+redwood@gmail.com people-ops 8h "onboarding checklist"` in #devex and include the template URL. The bot logs requests for auditing.
Taylor: Pinging now: `@Docs-bot request temp-editor taylor.dev+redwood@gmail.com people-ops 8h "onboarding checklist" https://notion.so/redwood/New-Hire-Onboarding-Checklist-Template`
Docs-bot: Request queued. Approval required from People Ops. Notification sent to @Nora (DevEx) and @PeopleOpsAdmin. :hourglass:
Infra-bot: FYI, if you need a quick local copy: open template -> ••• -> Export -> Markdown, then import into your personal workspace and move it after you have perms. Not ideal but works.
Nora (DevEx): Approved. Docs-bot: `grant taylor.dev+redwood@gmail.com editor people-ops temporary 8h`
Docs-bot: Granted Editor role for taylor.dev+redwood@gmail.com on space 'People Ops' for 8 hours. Audit ID: audit_2026_03_21_042. :white_check_mark:
Taylor: I accepted the invite and duplicated the checklist. Thank you! One more Q: where's the canonical naming convention for onboarding pages? I want the RFC to follow team standards.
Victor: See /docs -> Standards -> Naming & Templates -> Onboarding. Short rules: prefix "Onboard-<hire-name>-<role>-YYYYMMDD", add owner tag and manager, and include the onboarding checklist as a subpage.
Taylor: Got it. I favorited the Templates page. All good now, closing this thread. :smile:
